title: Validate dual-path streaming + tool/function-call compatibility with KV prefill and version pinning
creator: Marco Alvarez
description:
Background: New model variants coming through onboarding expose two streaming code paths: (A) direct token-stream from the runtime when KV cache is warm, and (B) prefilling + chunked stream where the controller injects a KV prefill before token emission. We also must verify that function/tool-calling semantics (handshake, tool invocation, tool result reintegration) behave identically across both paths and when a customer pins a model version to an older performance profile.

Scope: End-to-end verification of streaming + tool/function-calling compatibility for onboarded models. Tests must cover: handshake semantics, mid-stream tool invocation, tool result streaming back into the same stream, KV prefill behavior and cache invalidation, version-pinned fallbacks (when runtime chooses a compatible but lower-capacity variant), and publishing/validating the performance profile summary for the model in the catalog.

Non-goals: Non-streaming-only flows (blocking sync responses) are out of scope; downstream SDK integration tests live in a separate ticket.

Acceptance criteria: 
- AC1: A deterministic test harness reproduces both streaming paths (direct + prefilling) and can inject network jitter, chunk reordering, and partial chunk loss.
- AC2: For a given prompt that triggers a tool call mid-generation, both paths produce the same logical sequence of events (handshake -> tool invocation -> tool result -> resumed generation) within tolerance for token chunking.
- AC3: Pinning the model version to a previous performance profile causes documented behavior differences (latency/throughput), and the platform automatically records a compatibility note in the model catalog.
- AC4: Published performance profile (latency P50/P90, tokens/sec, memory footprint) matches observed numbers from the compatibility runs within +/-15% for representative prompt shapes.
- AC5: Automatic fallback to a compatible model variant under constrained capacity preserves tool-call correctness and emits an observable log event and metric for SLO auditing.
- AC6: Test harness artifacts (logs, traces, golden transcripts) are uploaded to the onboarding bucket and linked from the model onboarding page.

Test plan summary: 
- Create a new harness variant in the streaming test suite that can toggle KV prefill on/off and emulate tool endpoints with configurable delays and chunking patterns.
- Build a small set of canonical prompts that exercise: (1) tool call at 20% through generation, (2) nested tool calls, (3) long-context KV prefill scenarios.
- Run matrix across three model variants: newest onboarded (A), pinned older profile (B), and fallback smaller variant (C).
- Collect metrics (latency per phase, token throughput, successful tool-call ratio) and compare against published profile thresholds.

Notes: This ticket needs runtime infra to expose a 'simulate-prefill' flag and the catalog team to accept a new profile field 'compatibility-notes'.
